item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "7cf14722e89d1e99f50846e47111c5596834ecf08ffc64d34a7efefe511e4c6d",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Given a finite square real matrix A, defines the state-to-flux map v ↦ Av by matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The flux on the left side is precisely the fixed linear map v ↦ coefficient v.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef005 with the same arguments.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expands the right side into existence of time and space derivatives satisfying qt + A qx = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef004 with the same arguments.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expands the left side into existence of a time derivative and a spatial flux derivative whose sum is zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "There exist vectors qt and fluxx such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ flux(q(ξ,t)) has derivative fluxx at x, and qt + fluxx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines all three simultaneous requirements on the left, with flux(v) = Av.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "There exist vectors qt and qx such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + A qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the right side. Its existential qx is locally bound and distinct in scope from the universally supplied qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For every index type ι, real scalar multiplication on the function space ι → ℝ is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structural continuity for vector-valued differentiation in the local definitions; adds no hypothesis on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "For every index type ι, real scalar multiplication on the function space ι → ℝ is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same structural continuity for the second local derivative formulation; imposes no additional condition on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure of an additive commutative monoid, retaining its operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real and function-space action instances without changing vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Jointly continuous multiplication gives jointly continuous scalar action of a type on itself by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes real multiplication the continuous scalar action on each real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Regards a densely normed field as a nontrivially normed field while preserving its normed field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivially normed real scalar field required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the monoid action from a distributive monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the usual scalar action in the explicit real-vector structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations for modules and actions without changing them.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Constructs the semifield structure underlying a field, preserving its arithmetic and inverse operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the structural route from the real field to its scalar semiring; adds no restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the type of natural-number indices i with 0 ≤ i < m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Indexes the m coordinates and both matrix axes; it is empty when m = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all elements of Fin n using finRange n, with completeness and absence of duplicates.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the finite coordinate enumeration needed for matrix-vector sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that f has derivative vector f' at x, using the derivative filter with the moving point approaching x through nhds x and the base point fixed at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "All derivatives are ordinary derivatives of real-variable vector-valued slices at the specified points, with no restriction to a subset or one-sided domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence: each of two propositions implies the other.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts both directions between the two existential derivative conditions, conditional on the outer spatial derivative hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring has the corresponding topological semiring properties.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transfers the continuity of real ring operations to the structure used for scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts joint continuity of multiplication from the topological semiring properties.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of multiplication on ℝ, hence continuity of its scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row type I, column type J, and entry type K is a function I → J → K.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient is an arbitrary real m-by-m array A(i,j), with no additional matrix property assumed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action underlying a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves ordinary real scalar multiplication in the vector derivative structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the associative multiplication structure of a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports scalar-action instance construction without altering real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar monoid for module-derived actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semigroup action from a monoid action, preserving its action operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the instance chain identifying scalar multiplication on real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension m ranges over all nonnegative integers; positivity is not assumed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the required associativity law from a nonunital commutative ring structure while retaining its operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a weaker real algebraic interface used in the topology instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital nonassociative ring structure by forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real operations used to obtain topological ring consequences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, zero, and distributive laws while forgetting additive inverses as required structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real semiring interface for multiplication continuity without changing arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid from a nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real addition and zero to the function-space module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital commutative ring underlying a nonunital normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real arithmetic used by the topological ring instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital seminormed ring structure, forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate structure for the real seminormed additive group.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual normed additive structure on real coordinates for the scalar module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the structure without an associativity requirement from a nonunital semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the route to real additive monoid operations used in vector-space construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field structure of a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the standard real norm and field operations underlying differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains norm, metric, addition, and multiplication while forgetting the required multiplicative identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker normed real ring interface for the topological structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Regards a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same norm and induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the standard real topology and arithmetic in the derivative instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field structure of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real field arithmetic used in the scalar module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Constructs the underlying normed commutative ring with the same norm, metric, and ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed field to its compatible ring and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with scalar action given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes real scalar multiplication on each real coordinate ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module underlying a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real coordinate module used to form ℝ^m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Forms the module of functions I → β from a module β, with operations defined pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives Fin m → ℝ the usual real vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Functions into additive commutative groups form an additive commutative group under pointwise operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector addition, subtraction, and zero in derivative statements are coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology on a function space, constructed from the topologies induced by all coordinate evaluations.",
      "effect_on_target": "The codomain ℝ^m has its usual finite product topology, so the vector derivative statements are equivalent to the corresponding coordinate derivative statements.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform space underlying a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Carries the usual real distance into the topology used for limits and continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both independent variables, all coordinates, all matrix entries, and derivative scalars are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has norms attaining values strictly between any two positive real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the densely normed, hence nontrivially normed, scalar field instance used by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure of the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies coordinate addition, negation, and zero for the vector-valued derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines scalar multiplication on real coordinates and the arithmetic in matrix-vector products.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure of the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the ordinary real algebraic operations and laws used in the explicit module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring equipped with its usual norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the arithmetic and topology used for vector differentiation are the usual real ones.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its usual norm and metric, satisfying multiplicativity of the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar field and normed-space structures underlying all derivative assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric structure with distance d(x,y) = |x-y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the usual topology on the real inputs and each real output coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains real addition and multiplication for the additive and module instance chains.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the division semiring structure of a semifield, including its arithmetic and inverse operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "An intermediate step supplying the real scalar semiring; no condition on the coefficient matrix follows.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies the operation used by the coordinatewise continuous scalar multiplication instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminorm, pseudometric, and commutative ring operations while forgetting the required identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real additive seminormed structure without changing its topology or arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring structure from a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate interface for the real pseudometric used in scalar continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the compatible pseudometric space from a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar topology through its norm-induced distance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains multiplication, identity, zero, and their monoid-with-zero laws from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the multiplicative real scalar structure for module-derived actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital semiring structure while preserving addition, multiplication, and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real additive monoid used to construct the function-space module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual real topology and hence the product topology on vector values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Coordinatewise jointly continuous scalar actions induce a jointly continuous action on the product function space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures continuous real scalar multiplication on ℝ^m as required for HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The reals with their usual topology form a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuity of real arithmetic used to obtain continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite type structure supplies a finite exhaustive enumeration of the type's elements.",
      "effect_on_target": "The local definitions use finite index types, instantiated here by Fin m, allowing finite matrix-vector sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "The product of a matrix M and vector v has coordinate i equal to the dot product of row i with v, namely Σ_j M(i,j)v(j) over the finite column index type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the flux and the right-side coefficient term use A acting on a column vector, with no transpose: (Av)_i = Σ_{j=0}^{m-1} A_ij v_j.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction, requiring both propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Within each existential condition, both derivative assertions and the zero-sum equation must hold simultaneously for the same witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative sums equal the zero vector exactly, equivalently in every coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each side chooses its own pair of derivative vectors, after the outer parameters are fixed; the second witness is chosen within the scope of the first.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation supplied by a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here both operands and the result are vectors of the same type, and the operation is their ordinary pointwise sum.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral in a type through its OfNat instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed numeral 0 in the derivative equations as the vector zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Defines addition of functions by (f+g)(i) = f(i)+g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The equations qt + fluxx = 0 and qt + A qx = 0 are componentwise equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "Defines the zero function by assigning zero at every index.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right-hand zero in each vector equation is the vector with every coordinate equal to real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Ordinary real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coordinate sums in the derivative equations use real addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines every coordinate of the zero vector in the conclusions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the zero supplied by a Zero instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the written zero in the equations with the pointwise vector zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Turns an ordinary addition operation on a type into heterogeneous-addition notation with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed hAdd applications to ordinary vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "The scalar action map (a,v) ↦ a • v is jointly continuous for the specified topologies.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural requirement for the vector-valued derivative notion, satisfied here by ordinary real coordinatewise scaling.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Pi.instSMul",
      "meaning": "Defines scalar multiplication of functions coordinatewise: (a • f)(i) = a • f(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector derivative uses the usual real scalar action on ℝ^m.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m, including m = 0, let I = {0,...,m-1} and V = I → ℝ, identified with ℝ^m.",
      "For every function q : ℝ → ℝ → V; its first argument is the spatial variable and its second argument is the time variable in the formulas.",
      "For every fixed matrix A = coefficient : I → I → ℝ.",
      "For every pair of real numbers x and t.",
      "For every vector v₀ = qx ∈ V supplied as a candidate spatial derivative.",
      "Under the outer derivative hypothesis, the left side existentially binds a ∈ V and then b ∈ V. The right side independently existentially binds c ∈ V and then d ∈ V. These witnesses are chosen for the fixed outer data; there is no single witness required to work at all points."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "The real-variable map ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative v₀ at ξ = x, using the usual real topology and the finite product topology on V."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The following conditions are equivalent: (L) there exist a,b ∈ V such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative a at t, ξ ↦ A q(ξ,t) has derivative b at x, and a+b=0; (R) there exist c,d ∈ V such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative c at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative d at x, and c+Ad=0.",
      "Explicitly, the equation on the left is a_i+b_i=0 for every i∈I, and the equation on the right is c_i+Σ_{j∈I} A_ij d_j=0 for every i∈I. Each side requires both derivative assertions together with its equation."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "For v∈V, the flux F(v)=Av has coordinates F(v)_i=Σ_{j∈I} A_ij v_j. The same fixed matrix A is used at every argument of this flux.",
      "Vector addition and scalar multiplication are pointwise, and 0∈V is the function i↦0. V carries the product of the usual real topologies.",
